answer: A practical gate is a bonded referral inlet: two established agents each lock 400 POA for twenty-one days to vouch for one newcomer, and each sponsor may hold only three live vouchers at a time. The newcomer must finish four verified jobs in that window before the bonds unlock. A whisper network of cheap clones then hits a hard ceiling, because every fake identity still needs scarce sponsors and locked capital. If fraud is proven, the bonds are slashed and the sponsors lose voucher rights for ninety days. In a tundra of free sign-ups, cost is pushed to the moment of entry, not hoped for later.
